prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='CWT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while CWT_catboost best captures seasonality (0.6513). However, the series shows high unpredictability (spectral entropy 0.884) and unstable model rankings (Kendall τ=-0.0877), with extreme RMSE spread (3.45). This combination of factors strongly favors robust median/trimmed_mean combinations over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
